placeholder.notBuilt: This screen is not built yet.

errors.screenBody: This screen could not be shown. Reload to try again, or go to the dashboard.
errors.notFoundBody: There is no page at this address.

checkEmail.body: We sent a link to {{email}}. Open it to confirm your email address.
checkEmail.resent: We sent a new link to {{email}}.

verify.confirmedBody: Your email address is confirmed. You can sign in now.
verify.failedBody: This link is invalid or has expired. Sign in to get a new one.

forgotPassword.body: Enter the email address you sign in with, and we will send you a link to set a new password.
forgotPassword.sent: If {{email}} has a user, we sent a link to it. Open it to set a new password.

resetPassword.changedBody: Your password is changed. Sign in with your new password.
resetPassword.linkInvalidBody: This link is invalid, has been used or has expired. Ask for a new one.

notVerified.body: Confirm your email address before signing in. We sent you a link when you registered.
notVerified.resent: We sent a new link to {{email}}.

twoFactor.body: Open your authenticator app and enter the code it shows for Personal Finance Manager.
twoFactor.recoveryCodeBody: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved when you turned on two-factor sign-in. Each works once.

errors.codeIncorrect: That code is not right. Enter the newest code from your authenticator app.
errors.recoveryCodeIncorrect: That recovery code is not right, or has been used already.
errors.paused: Signing in is paused for 15 minutes after too many wrong attempts. Try again later.

errors.wrongCredentials: The email or password is incorrect.
errors.lockWarning: After 5 wrong attempts in a row, signing in is paused for 15 minutes.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a minute, then try again.

deletion.requested: You are signed out, and your profile will be deleted in 30 days. To keep it, sign in again before then.
deletion.cancelled: Welcome back. Signing in cancelled the deletion of your profile, and nothing was erased.

accounts.intro: The places your money sits, grouped by institution.
accounts.empty: No accounts yet. Add the accounts your money sits in.
accounts.notConvertedExplained: Not converted: {{amounts}}. No exchange rate is available yet, so it is left out of the total.
accounts.name: Name
accounts.openingBalanceHint: Below zero for an overdrawn account: start it with a minus sign.
accounts.amountOwedHint: Enter what you owe as a positive number. The account shows it as a negative balance.
accounts.last4Hint: Optional. Only the last 4 digits, to tell your accounts apart. Never enter a full account or card number.
accounts.creditLimitHint: Optional. With it, the account shows your available credit: the credit limit minus the amount owed.
accounts.archiveExplained: Archive {{name}}? It leaves pickers and lists, and stays in your history.
accounts.archiveNotZero: Its balance is not zero: {{balance}} stays in your totals and reports.

errors.type: Choose one of the account types.
errors.institution: Choose one of your institutions that is not archived.
errors.currencyLocked: The currency cannot change once the account has transactions.
errors.last4: Enter exactly 4 digits: the last 4 of the number, never all of it.
errors.creditLimit: Enter a credit limit, such as {{example}}, or leave it empty.
errors.day: Choose a day of the month, from 1 to 31.
errors.stale: This account was changed somewhere else since you opened it. The latest version is shown; check it and save again.

transactions.intro: Your income and expenses. Filter, search and sort them to find any one.

recentlyDeleted.title: Recently deleted
recentlyDeleted.intro: Transactions you deleted in the last 30 days. Restore one to return it to your lists and balances; after 30 days it is removed for good.
recentlyDeleted.notLoaded: Recently deleted transactions could not be loaded. Try again in a moment.
recentlyDeleted.empty: Nothing was deleted in the last 30 days.
recentlyDeleted.wholeTransfer: Restoring it restores the whole transfer.

transactions.empty: No transactions yet. Add your first income or expense.
transactions.noAccounts: A transaction is recorded on an account, and you have none yet.

total.title: Total of these transactions
total.spent: Spent in the category, as its budget counts it
total.spentNotConverted_one: {{count}} expense is not converted yet and is left out of spent.
total.spentNotConverted_other: {{count}} expenses are not converted yet and are left out of spent.

transactions.refundHint: Money coming back from a purchase. It raises the balance and lowers what you spent in the category.
transactions.categorySuggested: Suggested from your earlier transactions with this payee.

tags.label: Tags
tags.hint: Labels across categories, such as tet-2027 or japan-trip. Type one and press Enter, or pick one you have used.

transactions.savedAddAnother_one: Saved. Add another, or close when you are done.
transactions.savedAddAnother_other: {{count}} saved. Add another, or close when you are done.
transactions.deleteExplained: Delete {{name}}? It leaves this list and its account's balance.

errors.account: Choose one of your accounts that is not archived.
errors.amountZero: Enter an amount greater than zero.
errors.dateInFuture: The date cannot be in the future.
errors.tags: Use at most 20 tags, each of at most 50 characters.
errors.linesLeft: The lines must add up to the amount: {{amount}} left to split.
errors.linesOver: The lines must add up to the amount: they come to {{amount}} more.
errors.lines: Check the lines: each needs one of your categories that is not archived and an amount, and together they must add up to the amount.
errors.refundNotExpense: Only an expense can be a refund.
errors.stale: This transaction was changed somewhere else since you opened it. The latest version is shown; check it and save again.
errors.reconciled: This transaction is reconciled, so this cannot change.

transactions.reconciledLocked: This transaction is reconciled: its amount, date, account and type are locked until its reconciliation is reopened.

bulk.title: Selected transactions
bulk.deleteExplained_one: Delete {{count}} transaction? You can restore it from Recently deleted for 30 days.
bulk.deleteExplained_other: Delete {{count}} transactions? You can restore them from Recently deleted for 30 days.
bulk.refused: Nothing was changed: these transactions cannot take it.

refusals.transferLeg: a leg of a transfer has no category and changes only with its transfer.
refusals.split: a split transaction keeps its lines; edit it to change their categories.
refusals.categoryKind: income takes an income category, and an expense an expense one.
refusals.reconciled: it is reconciled, so it cannot move or be deleted until its reconciliation is reopened.
refusals.otherCurrency: a transaction moves only to an account in its own currency.

bulk.invalid: That category or account can no longer be chosen. Choose again.
bulk.failed: The selected transactions were not changed.

transfers.bothAmounts: These accounts are in different currencies, so enter both amounts. No exchange rate is looked up.
transfers.deleteExplained: Delete this transfer? Both of its legs leave this list, and both accounts get their balance back.
transfers.markTitle: Picked to mark as a transfer
transfers.markExplained: Pick an expense on one account and the income it became on another, such as the two rows imported statements show for paying a card. Once marked, neither counts as spending or income.

whyNot.types: Pick one expense and one income.
whyNot.sameAccount: A transfer is between two different accounts.
whyNot.date: The two must be on the same date.
whyNot.amount: Between accounts in one currency, the two must be of the same amount.

transfers.unmarkExplained: Turn this transfer back into an expense and income. A leg of a transfer has no category, so choose one for each.

errors.account: Choose one of your accounts that is not archived.
errors.sameAccount: Choose a different account from the one the money leaves.
errors.amountZero: Enter an amount greater than zero.
errors.dateInFuture: The date cannot be in the future.
errors.stale: This transfer was changed somewhere else since you opened it. The latest version is shown; check it and save again.
errors.notLoaded: The transfer could not be loaded. Try again.
errors.deleteReconciled: This transfer is reconciled, so it cannot be deleted until its reconciliation is reopened.
errors.markRefused: These two could not be marked as a transfer: one of them changed somewhere else. Check them and try again.
errors.notMarked: The two were not marked as a transfer.
errors.categoryArchived: Choose one of your categories that is not archived.
errors.reconciled: This transfer is reconciled, so this cannot change.

transfers.reconciledLocked: This transfer is reconciled: its accounts, amounts and date are locked until its reconciliation is reopened.

attachments.title: Attachments
attachments.hint: JPEG, PNG or PDF, up to 5 MB each.

errors.type: {{name}} is not a JPEG, PNG or PDF file.
errors.refused: {{name}} could not be attached. Attach a JPEG, PNG or PDF file of at most 5 MB.
errors.notLoaded: The attachments could not be loaded.
errors.notOpened: The attachment could not be opened.

recurring.intro: Income and expenses that repeat, such as salary, rent and subscriptions. Each is recorded for you on its due date.
recurring.empty: No recurring rules yet. Add one for your salary, rent or anything else that repeats.
recurring.noAccounts: A recurring rule records on an account, and you have none yet.
recurring.monthEndHint: In a month too short for the day it starts on, it is due on the last day of that month.
recurring.startInPastHint: Starts in the past: every occurrence since then is recorded, each on its own due date.
recurring.remindersIntro: Due by today and waiting for you: confirm to record each one, or dismiss it.
recurring.upcomingEmpty: Nothing is due in the next {{days}} days.
recurring.deleteExplained: Delete {{name}}? It records nothing more. The transactions it already recorded stay.

errors.account: Choose one of your accounts that is not archived.
errors.amountZero: Enter an amount greater than zero.
errors.interval: Enter a whole number of days, from 1 to 365.
errors.endDate: Enter an end date, or leave it empty.
errors.endBeforeStart: The end date cannot be before the start date.
errors.mode: Choose what happens on each due date.
errors.answerEarlierFirst: Confirm or dismiss the earlier reminder of this rule first.
errors.stale: This recurring rule was changed somewhere else since you opened it. The latest version is shown; check it and save again.
errors.notSaved: The recurring rule was not saved.
errors.notChanged: The recurring rule was not changed.
errors.notDeleted: The recurring rule was not deleted.

budgets.intro: How much you plan to spend in each expense category, month by month, against what you have spent.
budgets.empty: No budgets for this month yet. Enter an amount next to a category to set one.
budgets.subcategoriesBudgeted: Its subcategories have budgets of their own this month.
budgets.progressOfZero: {{name}}: spent against a budget of zero
budgets.notConverted_one: {{count}} expense is not converted yet and is left out of spent.
budgets.notConverted_other: {{count}} expenses are not converted yet and are left out of spent.

copy.done_zero: No budgets copied from {{month}}: every category with a budget there already has one this month or takes none.
copy.failed: The budgets could not be copied.

errors.notLoaded: The budgets could not be loaded.
errors.amount: Enter an amount of zero or more, such as {{example}}.
errors.category: This category cannot take a budget this month: a category and its subcategory cannot both have one.
errors.stale: This budget was changed somewhere else. The latest amount is shown; check it and save again.
errors.notSaved: The budget could not be saved.
errors.notRemoved: The budget could not be removed.

filters.title: Report filters
filters.fromAfterTo: Start the period on or before the day it ends.
filters.toBeforeFrom: End the period on or after the day it starts.

reports.notConverted_one: {{count}} amount is not converted into your base currency yet and is left out.
reports.notConverted_other: {{count}} amounts are not converted into your base currency yet and are left out.

errors.notLoaded: The report could not be loaded. Try again in a moment.

spending.title: Spending by category
spending.empty: Nothing was spent in this period.
spending.nothingToDraw: Nothing to draw: more came back than was spent in every category.
spending.noTransactions: No transactions in this category in this period.

trends.title: Trends
trends.chooseWhat: Choose a category or type a payee to follow it month by month.
trends.payeeHint: Follow one payee, only in the category chosen when there is one.
trends.followByHint: What a payee is followed by when no category is chosen.

income.title: Income vs expenses
income.chart: Income and expenses per month, with net

budgetVsActual.title: Budget vs actual
budgetVsActual.noBudgets: No budget was set in these months.
budgetVsActual.unbudgetedHint: Spent in a month when neither the category nor its parent had a budget.

netWorth.title: Net worth
netWorth.chart: Net worth: assets and liabilities at each month end
netWorth.table: Net worth at each month end

monthlySummary.title: Monthly summary
monthlySummary.body: Download one month's income, expenses, savings rate, spending by category and budgets as a PDF.
monthlySummary.failed: The monthly summary could not be downloaded.

institutions.intro: The banks and wallet providers you hold money with.
institutions.empty: No institutions yet. Add the banks and wallet providers you hold money with.
institutions.name: Name
institutions.archiveExplained: Archive {{name}}? It leaves pickers and lists, and stays on the accounts that already use it.

profile.title: Profile
profile.baseCurrencyHint: Totals, budgets and reports are shown in this currency.
profile.baseCurrencyLocked: The base currency is locked because you have a budget: budgets are amounts you entered in it.
profile.timeZoneHint: Decides which day “today” is, and where a budget month starts and ends.
profile.budgetWarningHint: A budget’s state becomes a warning once this share of it is spent.
profile.saveFailed: Your settings could not be saved. Try again.

errors.baseCurrency: This base currency cannot be chosen.
errors.timeZone: This time zone cannot be chosen.
errors.baseCurrencyLocked: The base currency cannot change while you have a budget.
errors.budgetWarningPercent: Enter a whole percentage from 1 to 100.

security.title: Security
security.failed: Something went wrong. Try again in a little while.

password.title: Password
password.changed: Your password is changed. You are signed out everywhere else.

errors.currentIncorrect: That is not your current password.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor sign-in
twoFactor.intro: With two-factor sign-in, signing in takes your password and a code from an authenticator app on your phone.
twoFactor.scan: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app.
twoFactor.qrCode: QR code to scan with your authenticator app
twoFactor.keyInstead: Cannot scan it? Enter this key in the app instead:
twoFactor.confirm: Enter the code the app shows, to confirm it is set up.
twoFactor.recoveryCodesBody: Save these codes somewhere safe. Each one signs you in once if you lose your authenticator app. They are shown only now.
twoFactor.newRecoveryCodesBody: Your old recovery codes will stop working. Enter your password to get new ones.
twoFactor.turnOffBody: Signing in will take only your password. Enter it to turn off two-factor sign-in.

errors.codeIncorrect: That code is not right. Enter the newest code from your authenticator app.

confirmWithPassword.failed: Something went wrong. Try again in a little while.

export.title: Export your data
export.body: Download everything the app holds about you as one ZIP file: your profile as JSON, and your transactions and everything else you have entered as CSV files, which any spreadsheet opens.
export.confirmBody: The file holds all your financial data, and anyone who has the file can read it. Keep it somewhere safe.
export.failed: Something went wrong. Try again in a little while.

delete.title: Delete your profile
delete.body: Deleting your profile signs you out everywhere at once. For 30 days you can change your mind: sign in again and the deletion is cancelled. After 30 days everything you have entered is erased for good, and nobody can bring it back.
delete.confirmBody: You will be signed out now. In 30 days your profile and everything in it is erased, unless you sign in again before then. Enter your password to go ahead.

categories.title: Categories
categories.archiveConfirm: Archive {{name}}? It disappears from pickers and stays on existing transactions.
categories.archiveConfirmWithSubcategories: Archive {{name}} and its subcategories? They disappear from pickers and stay on existing transactions.
categories.name: Name
categories.kindHint: Its subcategories change kind with it.

errors.kindLocked: The kind cannot change once the category has transactions.
errors.parentRefused: A subcategory cannot be added here: the category above it is a subcategory itself, is archived or no longer exists.

reconciliations.title: Reconcile {{name}}
reconciliations.intro: Check the account against a bank statement: enter its closing date and balance, tick each transaction the statement shows, and complete it once the difference is zero.
reconciliations.closingBalanceHint: As the statement shows it. For an amount owed, put a minus sign in front.
reconciliations.nothingToTick: No transactions on this account up to {{date}} are left to tick.
reconciliations.completeWhenZero: It can be completed once the difference is exactly zero.
reconciliations.completed: Reconciled to {{date}}. Its transactions are locked.

errors.statementDateInFuture: A statement date cannot be in the future.
errors.statementDateRefused: Enter a statement date that is not in the future, nor before the last reconciliation.
errors.inProgress: This account already has a reconciliation in progress. It is shown now.

errors.notLoaded: The dashboard could not be loaded.

start.title: Start by adding an account
start.body: Add the accounts your money is in, such as a bank account, a card or cash. Your balance, spending and budgets will show here.

balance.title: Total balance
balance.notConverted: Not included: {{amounts}}, for want of an exchange rate.

budgets.title: Budgets this month
budgets.counts: {{onTrack}} on track, {{warning}} at warning, {{over}} over budget

upcoming.title: Coming up
upcoming.empty: Nothing is due in the next 30 days.
